Configure current feature

  1. Author faction thresholds/services and trainer curriculum. Add respec/learn/unlock quotes to suitable NPCs and server-recorded reputation events.
  2. Register Hearthford safe hub fast travel and a bounded Riverwatch world event with source-event IDs; require unlocked destination and no blocked combat/trade state.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Complete one recorded faction action, inspect standing/price/unlock change and replay the event.
  2. Train a valid unlock at Tovin; insufficient reputation/currency/level rejects without debit.
  3. Unlock a safe hub and fast travel, reusing the06handoff protocol; cancel an invalid destination before any fee commit.
  4. Start/end/reset Riverwatch through development event controls; verify event rewards once per definition eligibility.
Expected success
One reputation event applies once and remains bounded; service prices are serverquoted, not UIcomputed truth.
Fast travel uses current session fencing and safe destination validation; world event reset does not repeat a receipt.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Faction geopolitics and uncontrolled ecosystem simulation are out of scope. Additional professions use the verified resource/craft architecture.

Expected rejection and concurrency results

SystemStimulus -> expected outcome
current-phase fixtureNegative/overflow standings, invalid hub, active trade/combat and duplicate event reward reject consistently.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

Server-recorded reputation and paid travel/training are validated and durable.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
